page_subtitle: From enterprise frustration to discovering zero-egress architecture.

backstory.title: The Problem
backstory.text: Working in enterprise operations, I saw companies drowning in their own data. Brilliant teams wasting weeks on manual reports, valuable data trapped in silos, and critical decisions made without the right information.

wall.title: The Wall
wall.text: Every AI solution we evaluated required MOVING data out of the warehouse — to external APIs, to cloud providers, to third parties. The result: compliance risks, unacceptable latency, and costs growing exponentially.

epiphany.title: The Epiphany
epiphany.text: What if AI goes to the data, instead of data going to AI? That simple question changed everything. The zero-egress architecture was born: artificial intelligence deploys INSIDE the client's data warehouse.

achievement.title: The Result
achievement.text: The Strategist — 282 million records across 1,046 tables analyzed in seconds, zero data egress, 270% ROI. The Executor — 13 creative execution tools with generative AI (Imagen 3, Veo 2) adapting content to 11+ platforms. Proof that the paradigm works at enterprise scale.

items.title: Native Truth
items.description: Answers are born directly from YOUR data. No intermediaries, no distortions, no hallucinations.

items.title: Sovereignty
items.description: Your data never leaves your infrastructure. Zero-egress is not a feature, it's our fundamental architecture.

items.title: Speed
items.description: From days to seconds, verifiable. 694M+ transactions queried in seconds. Not promises — real metrics.

items.title: Evidence
items.description: Every metric is real and auditable. 270% ROI, 7.7-day payback, 59,378 profiles. Production data, not demos.

items.title: Living Architecture
items.description: The system grows with your business. New departments, new AI neurons, new intelligence — without rebuilding.
